Chapter 470: Chapter 12 Immortal King’s Demeanor (Please Subscribe)_2

Cangqing Immortal felt emotional and didn’t know how to describe Lin Yuan.

Whether it was an ordinary Immortal King or a Supreme Immortal King, for him the difference was not significant, as either way, they were beings he couldn’t look up to.

“As for the destruction of Huailong Palace, just speak the truth outwardly,” Lin Yuan said indifferently.

The meaning of this statement was that there was no need to hide that the mysterious Immortal King who destroyed Huailong Palace was the Martial Ancestor.

This decision was made by Lin Yuan after careful deliberation, as with his current strength, there was absolutely no need to hide his identity.

Revealing part of his strength had many benefits.

...

One was to greatly promote the Martial Tao Cultivation System.

To let more cultivators embark on the path of the Martial Tao.

A cultivation system where the peak combat power is a True Immortal compared to one where the peak combat power is an Immortal King, belongs to entirely different concepts.

As the Martial Ancestor, equal to a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King, Lin Yuan, without saying more, at least proved that Martial Tao is also a path that reaches to the heavens.

Second, Lin Yuan had always wanted to contact the other Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings of the Spirit Realm, but these Celestial Kings were either completely untraceable or too far away.

Since that was the case, Lin Yuan decided to reveal his strength and actively attract those Celestial Kings to come to him.

“Yes,” Cangqing Immortal said respectfully.

Passing a message, for the Daode Immortal Sect, was not a difficult task.

…

The destruction of the Huailong Palace caused a huge stir in the entire Dongyun Tao Province and even the nearby provinces were shaken by the news.

It wasn’t that the Huailong Palace had a huge influence; in fact, even if the Huailong Palace had obtained the essence of heavenly water, it still would have been hard for it to compare with the core domains of a province.

The reason Huailong Palace caused such a big commotion was entirely because the being who acted against Huailong Palace was almost certainly a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King.

The emergence of a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King could completely shake province after province, sparking discussions like a tsunami.

“Who exactly was the Celestial King that took action?”

“I’m also curious. It’s just the Huailong Palace. A Celestial King would just need to say the word, and I’d personally go to destroy it. Why would a Celestial King need to act personally?”

“In Dongyun Tao Province, we finally have another Celestial King.”

…

In the Xuanwang Domain, Dongyun Tao Province, as well as many other provinces, numerous True Immortals were abuzz.

This was about a Celestial King, after all.

True Immortals at the peak of the Unity Realm, after centuries, would only have hoped to see one or two Celestial Kings if they traveled across three thousand provinces.

While numerous forces discussed the origins of that mysterious Celestial King…

A force from Xuanwang Domain named Daode Immortal Sect publicly declared that the mysterious Celestial King who destroyed the Huailong Palace was none other than the Ancestor of the Martial Temple.

The news spread like a hurricane.

The true identity of a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King—what crucial information this was!

“The Ancestor of the Martial Temple? I have some impression of the Martial Temple, a cultivation system more focused on forging the physical body, and its strongest should only be comparable to a True Immortal. A cultivation system like that, capable of producing a Celestial King?”

“Is that real? A Martial Temple limited to inside a city actually has a Celestial King presiding over it?”

“It shouldn’t be fake; even with immense gall, the Daode Immortal Sect wouldn’t dare to fabricate the identity of a Celestial King, right?”

…

Although many True Immortals had doubts about the information, that the mysterious Celestial King came from the Martial Temple, none dared to openly object.

Absolutely joking.

You might object to other Great Realm forces. What can they do to you, after all, separated by a Great Realm, even if they were half-step Celestial Kings, they would be unable to reach you.

But to publicly doubt a Celestial King… Across three thousand provinces, even the most desolate places, if you run far enough, still cannot block a Celestial King’s malice.

…

“No more, I’m heading to Xuanwang Domain to pay a visit to that Martial Ancestor, a being on par with a Celestial King.”

“Me too. If the Martial Ancestor agrees to accept me as a disciple, I’m willing to forsake all my cultivation and follow the path of Martial Tao Cultivation.”

“Accept you as a disciple? Do you not look in the mirror at yourself? That’s a Celestial King-level powerhouse adopting a disciple?”

…

Many True Immortals from dozens of nearby provinces began heading towards Dongyun Tao Province.

True Immortals at the Peak of the Unity Realm, the hope of meeting a Celestial King was through such an occurrence, a Celestial King revealing traces at a certain place.

Attracting numerous other True Immortals to come from thousands of miles away.

…

Compared to the True Immortals drawn by reputation.

Numerous lower-level cultivators were even more thrilled.

“The Martial Tao Cultivation System can actually produce Celestial King-level powerhouses?”

“Just what I need. My Spirit Root aptitude is lacking, my potential in the Immortal Path limited, I’ve decided, I’m going to the Martial Temple to ask for apprenticeship.”

“Yes, the Martial Tao Cultivation System is home to Immortal King Level powerhouses. Becoming a Martial Dao Cultivator is far superior to joining those forces, most of which have never had an Immortal King Level powerhouse.”

…

Martial Temple.

Many Martial Dao Cultivators seemed bewildered.

“What? Our Martial Ancestor not only returned but also became an Immortal King Level powerhouse and casually destroyed the Huailong Palace?”

“This this this…”

Many cultivators who had just joined the Martial Temple suddenly felt as if blessings had fallen from the sky.

Originally joining the Martial Temple meant they could not compete with the disciples of the Daode Immortal Sect and the Xuanwang Hall, but now, it should be those disciples licking their wounds, shouldn’t it?

…

Outside Xianyao City.

Jun Haiqiu, Jun Nangong, and Jun Yunxun, three outstanding descendants of the Jun Family, finally arrived at Xianyao City.

“Our Wuji Ancestor became an Immortal King?”

Jun Haiqiu and the others looked at each other. They weren’t Cangqing Immortal; they had taken quite some time to get to Xianyao City from the Daode Immortal Sect.

However, en route, they had received the news that the Martial Ancestor was now an Immortal King Level powerhouse.

“Wuji Ancestor, who disappeared for hundreds of thousands of years, has reappeared as an Immortal King Level powerhouse? Why do I feel like I’m dreaming?”

The three descendants of the Jun Family felt that happiness came too suddenly, too intensely, and was somewhat hard to bear.

They had imagined Wuji Ancestor to be very strong, after all, they had heard legends about him from childhood, but they thought he would be on par with the Cangqing Immortal at most.

As for an Immortal King?

They never considered it.

If it were easy to reach the status of an Immortal King,

the Spirit Realm’s three thousand Tao provinces wouldn’t have so few Immortal Kings.

“Has Wuji Ancestor become an Immortal King, and might not want to see us?” Jun Haiqiu asked hesitantly.

That was an Immortal King.

High above all.

Overlooking the three thousand Tao provinces.

“No matter what, he is still our ancestral patriarch of the Jun Family; we should pay him a visit,” Jun Nangong hesitated briefly then made a decision. Now that they were in Xianyao City, even if they couldn’t meet him, they still had to try.

…

The Fourth Heaven.

A purple-robed elder suddenly stopped.

He glanced at the location of Dongyun Tao Province below.

“Unexpectedly, even in such a remote Tao province, a fellow daoist has emerged…” the purple-robed elder was also a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King.

The vast Spirit Realm had so few Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings that it was a rare occasion to see a fellow daoist, naturally stirring his intention to visit.

“Martial Ancestor… I’ve not heard of this title before, seems to be a newly ascended Immortal King?”

The purple-robed elder surmised internally.

The powerful Immortal Kings, such as the Supreme Immortal King, revered across the three thousand Tao provinces, even other Immortal Kings must display sufficient reverence.

Martial Ancestor?

The purple-robed elder, who considered himself well-informed and well-connected, had never heard of an Immortal King by this title.

Therefore, he believed it was a very reasonable guess that this Martial Ancestor had only recently ascended to the Tribulation Transcendence Stage.

Whoosh.

The purple-robed elder appeared in an instant outside Xianyao City, stopping at a distant mountaintop.

“Let me see what kind of presence this newly ascended Immortal King has,” the purple-robed elder’s eyes faintly emitted a purple light.

After ascending to the Tribulation Transcendence Stage, an Immortal King’s life begins to affect his surroundings, even linking with the heaven and earth of the Spirit Realm, hence revealing certain ‘phenomena’.

Such phenomena, having no concrete form, are hard to observe, but the purple-robed elder cultivated a secret technique that could capture these kinds of Immortal King phenomena to some extent.

“If it’s a newly ascended Immortal King, the phenomena should be small. Those veteran Immortal Kings, even the Supreme Immortal King, just their own phenomena can stir the Nine Heavens…”

While thinking, the purple-robed elder observed the position of Xianyao City.

The longer one cultivated during the Tribulation Transcendence Stage, the stronger they became, the greater their influence on their surroundings, and thus the more terrifying the Immortal King phenomena became…

almost like those ‘wonders’ and ‘anomalies’ in the Nine Heavens.

Through the Immortal King phenomena, one could also somewhat judge the Immortal King’s strength.

“This?!!”

The more the purple-robed elder observed, the more noticeable his change in expression, ultimately revealing a look of shock.
